pipeline: durable AgentEvent -> (mirror sessions/*.jsonl) -> derive() episodes -> derive_symbol_exposures -> build_memory + enrich_symbols -> MemoryStore
incremental: checkpoint-bounded; only sessions with new tail events re-derive; unchanged episodes reused
async: runs on the derived worker checkpoint boundary — never blocks the ingest ACK path; lag measured via derived_lag_events
replay_equivalent: derive() is deterministic over the durable log; second run over same log is a no-op delta (verified)
multi_session_isolation: 10 in-scope sessions + 1 foreign-scope session; foreign entry keeps own scope and never matches a scoped query (verified)
